title: Spendthrift nobleman
html_source:
Aldborough House was built in 1796 by Edward Stratford. The foundation was laid down in 1792. Aldborough was still not fully completed by 1798. It is the biggest Georgian private residence in the capital. Lord Aldborough failed to take into account the consequences of the 1800 Act of Union (for which he voted) which led to a precipitate decline in the city’s fortunes and left his great town house stranded.
